scope: Public supported interfaces; selected customer tenant has not been inspected.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: fixedAsset resource
sources.observation: Standard master-card field list; GUID id; financial-book coverage must be checked against actual tenant metadata.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: update fixedAssets
sources.observation: If-Match required; update changed properties. Examples conflict with the resource property list and GUID typing.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: API v2 overview
sources.observation: API Overview identifies installed APIs; custom API needed for additional field exposure.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: fixed-asset setup
sources.observation: Depreciation book G/L integration determines the relevant native financial journal.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: company configuration packages
sources.observation: Configuration packages/templates support company setup and master-data import.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: S2S authentication
sources.observation: Existing Entra application uses client-credentials and BC object permissions; API and automation privileges are distinct.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: OData paging
sources.observation: Server-driven pages; Prefer odata.maxpagesize; every continuation must be retained.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: API limits
sources.observation: 429 cooldown, bounded requests, 504 request-timeout recovery and continuation capture.

sources.title: Dynaway: native assets GET
sources.observation: Maintenance assetNo/parentAssetNo/fixedAssetNumber and native id are distinct identities.

sources.title: Dynaway: create resource line
sources.observation: Resource/UoM/work type, quantities, consumed state and native line/document identities.

sources.title: Dynaway: create item line
sources.observation: Item/UoM quantities and native line/document identities.

sources.title: Dynaway: create expense line
sources.observation: Expense/vendor/UoM, expected LCY unit cost, quantities and native identities.

sources.title: Dynaway: work-order ledger entries
sources.observation: Posted analytics fields include expense expected/actual LCY; sample lacks complete resource/item cost and order-header identity.

sources.title: Dynaway: post work order
sources.observation: Explicit bound posting action; published URI has a missing parenthesis, requiring actual metadata resolution.

sources.title: Dynaway: project integration
sources.observation: Project and receiving project line must be marked Maintenance; resource/item/expense posting and project-task linkage.

sources.title: Dynaway: dimension setup
sources.observation: EAM_MAINT default dimension priorities and dimensions applied at work-order creation.

sources.title: Dynaway: assisted setup
sources.observation: Installed Excel templates for assets, fixed-asset links, plans, warranties, counters and measurements.

sources.title: Dynaway: maintenance budgets
sources.observation: Scenario budgets are planned resource/item/expense amounts with periods and dimensions, separate from posted actuals.
